title: Anvil
wikitext:
An '''anvil''' is a large, heavy, [[metal]] environmental [[object]] with a flat top surface and a point on one end most frequently found on a sturdy block of wood or pedestal. An anvil is required for most [[blacksmithing]] and [[engineering]] [[recipe]]s. You do not have to interact with the anvil, you just have to be in the vicinity of the anvil.

An anvil graphic is not necessarily a functional anvil in the game. Generally, a usable anvil will be selectable (but does not have to be selected).

Anvils are usually found in [[cities]] and towns, often paired with a [[forge]] (which has similar use characteristics).
